title: Comparing Tesla, Ford, & VW's Electrical Architectures
summary: Sandy Munro sits down with engineers from 3IS to compare the electrical architectures of the Tesla Model Y, Ford Mach-E and VW ID.4. They discuss ECU counts, bus architectures and what the differences mean for cost and integration.
why: HN recommends it as a fair, technical comparison and cites it when discussing why legacy automakers have more boxes and complexity than Tesla.

quote.text: I'm not a Tesla fanboy but I didn't think it was biased.
